name: Run the unified Loop B + Loop A closed-loop harness cycle
description: Execute the full autonomous Loop B and Loop A cycle on a GCP lab VM: harvest production and canary failures, step through the 24-unit Master Curriculum Playbook across every organ, engineering role, and specialist role, evaluate concrete workspace artifacts with the Frontier Model Committee under the Capability-First Credo, and promote winning branches as GitHub pull requests against the primary repository.
narrative:
1. Validate the candidate repository checkout with `harness-cycle --action validate --repo . --json`.
2. Run Loop B failure harvesting and curriculum expansion with `harness-eval --action harvest --stage all --expand-curriculum --persist --json`.
3. Step through the next unit of the 24-unit Master Curriculum Playbook (6 organs, 7 engineering roles, 11 specialist roles) producing concrete workspace deliverables evaluated by deterministic artifact verifiers and the Frontier Model Committee via `harness-cycle --action curriculum --real-model --vertex --apply --push-pr --json`. Only a `--real-model` run sends each side's own prompts to the model, on the model suite's checked tasks, so only it can open a pull request; it stops at its spend cap and says so.
4. Diagnose four-lens bottlenecks across roles with `harness-cycle --action diagnose --stage all --trials 2 --live --judge-committee --json`.
5. Run Loop A recursive evolution under the Capability-First Credo with `harness-cycle --action run --stage all --iterations 2 --candidates 2 --trials 2 --live --vertex --judge-committee --include-harvested --expand-curriculum --json`.
6. Verify promotion gates and open a pull request against the primary repository with `harness-promote --action verify --repo . --stage all --role generic --real-model --vertex --apply --push-pr --json` (one role, so the run fits its spend cap).
